subject: gk
question: Under the PM-KISAN Yojana, how much financial assistance is provided to eligible farmers annually?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹ 6,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)** is a **Central Sector Scheme** launched to provide financial assistance to landholding farmer families across the **country**.
 
• Under this scheme, an annual financial benefit of **₹ 6,000** is provided to all eligible farmer families to help them meet expenses related to **agriculture** and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
 
• The total amount of **₹ 6,000** is released in **three equal installments** of **₹ 2,000** each, distributed every **four months** (quadrimestrial periods) during the **financial year**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** officially launched the scheme on **24th February 2019** at **Gorakhpur**, **Uttar Pradesh**, although it was made operational with effect from **1st December 2018**.
 
• The scheme is **100%** funded by the **Government of India**, ensuring that the entire financial burden is borne by the **Union Government** without requiring state contributions for the benefit amount.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nodal Ministry and Implementation:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**.
 
• While the funds come from the Centre, the responsibility of identifying the eligible farmer families as per the scheme guidelines rests with the **State Governments** and **Union Territory Administrations**.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of Coverage:**
 
 
• At its inception, the benefit was restricted to **Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs)** families having combined landholding of up to **2 hectares**.
 
• The scheme was later revised with effect from **1st June 2019** to extend its benefits to all farmer families in the **country**, regardless of the size of their landholdings, subject to certain exclusion criteria.
 
 
 
• **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):**
 
 
• To ensure transparency and prevent leakages, the financial assistance is transferred directly into the **bank accounts** of the beneficiaries through **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** mode.
 
• Beneficiaries can track their status and register themselves through the official **PM-KISAN portal** or the **mobile app**.
 
 
 
• **Exclusion Categories:**
 
 
• Not all farmers are eligible; exclusions include **institutional landholders**, individuals holding **constitutional posts**, and **income taxpayers** in the last assessment **year**.
 
• Professionals such as **Doctors**, **Engineers**, **Lawyers**, and **Chartered Accountants**, as well as retired pensioners whose monthly pension is **₹ 10,000** or more, are also excluded from the scheme.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Definition of Family:** For the purpose of the scheme, a **family** is defined as a **husband**, **wife**, and **minor children**.
 
• **Impact and Reach:** Since its launch in **2019**, the **Government of India** has released numerous installments, benefiting more than **11 crore** farmers and disbursing over **₹ 2.8 lakh crore** to date.
 
• **e-KYC Requirement:** To continue receiving the benefits, the **Government** has made **e-KYC** mandatory for all registered farmers to verify their identity and ensure the money reaches the right hands.
 
• **Data Management:** The **PM-KISAN** database is integrated with **land records** of various states to validate the ownership of land, which is a primary requirement for eligibility.
